'@
$destinationRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Destination)
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destinationRoot) { throw "Destination already exists: $destinationRoot. Choose a new folder with -Destination." }
$items = ConvertFrom-Json -InputObject $payload
$prefix = $destinationRoot.TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar) + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
foreach ($item in $items) {
    $path = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $destinationRoot $item.Path))
    if (-not $path.StartsWith($prefix, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw "Invalid path: $($item.Path)" }
    $null = [Convert]::FromBase64String($item.Data)
}
$null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($destinationRoot)
foreach ($item in $items) {
    $path = Join-Path $destinationRoot $item.Path
    $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($path))
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($path, [Convert]::FromBase64String($item.Data))
}
Write-Host "Restored $($items.Count) files to $destinationRoot"
